['Voith GmbH & Co. KGaA '].company_description: The Voith Group is a German multinational technology company with a broad portfolio of systems, products, services and digital applications. Voith works in the markets of energy, paper, raw materials and transport & automotive. Founded in 1867, the company today has around 21,000 employees, sales of €4.9 billion and locations in over 60 countries worldwide and is thus one of the larger family-owned companies in Europe.

['Edeka Handelsgesellschaft Rhein-Ruhr m.company_description: EDEKA Handelsgesellschaft Rhein-Ruhr mbH operates as a part of EDEKA Rhein-Ruhr and is known for its beverage markets with a wide range of offerings, good value for money, and comprehensive service. The company has been a subsidiary of EDEKA Rhein-Ruhr since 2011. EDEKA Rhein-Ruhr reported a 3% increase in annual revenue to 5.9 billion euros for the year 2022.
